task: Define OCR, translation, rendering stage boundaries
goal: Clarify each stage's input, output, error, and artifact boundaries, avoid mixing responsibilities at call layer
done_definition: runtime pipeline README clearly describes stage boundaries; translation/rendering/document_schema README consistent with actual entry points
completion_notes: Added OCR/Normalize, Translation, Rendering three-stage contracts; clarified document.v1.json is stable handoff from OCR to downstream, translation stage only produces translation payload, rendering stage only consumes source PDF and translation artifacts.

goal: Replace rendering stage dependency on fixed page-*-deepseek.json filenames, ensuring rendering only consumes stable artifact protocols
done_definition: Manifest fields, generation location, read fallback, and README documentation completed; legacy page JSON compatibility strategy defined
completion_notes: Added translation-manifest.json; translation main line automatically persists manifest, rendering prioritizes manifest and falls back to legacy page-*-deepseek.json if missing.

goal: Specify that render-only mode requires source PDF, translation manifest, or translations dir, and standardize error messages
done_definition: render_stage/build_book entry points can read artifacts per protocol; errors for missing artifacts are readable; README updated
completion_notes: Added render_inputs.py for unified Render-only input validation; build_book/run_render_stage now supports translation_manifest_path; unified Render-only input error thrown when source PDF, manifest, or legacy payload is missing.

task: Add Translate workflow design and type
goal: Add independent translation task type in Rust API layer to avoid indirect triggering via old full main chain
done_definition: WorkflowKind, request validation, task creation, and lifecycle entry support Translate; old workflow compatibility preserved
completion_notes: Rust API added WorkflowKind::Translate; create_job supports translate workflow; lifecycle creates OCR sub-task first, then calls independent run_translate_only.py to produce only translation directory and translation-manifest.json, removing forced rendering.

task: Add Render workflow design and type
goal: Add independent rendering task type in Rust API layer to support re-running rendering based on existing translation artifacts
done_definition: WorkflowKind, request validation, task creation, and lifecycle entry support Render; can reuse existing job artifacts
completion_notes: Rust API added WorkflowKind::Render; request points to existing job via source.artifact_job_id; lifecycle reuses source_pdf and translations_dir, calling independent run_render_only.py to re-run rendering without repeating OCR/translation.

goal: Retain one-click full task but explicitly chain OCR, Translate, and Render internally instead of hiding translation and rendering in a single Python entry
done_definition: Full task remains compatible with existing interfaces; stage status, cancellation, and failure attribution can be mapped to OCR/Translate/Render respectively
completion_notes: Full mineru workflow changed to OCR sub-task -> run_translate_only.py -> run_render_only.py; enters rendering stage after Translate-only success; failure/cancellation stops at corresponding stage; old create_job entry remains compatible.

goal: Register normalized document, translation manifest, and rendered PDF as trackable artifacts
done_definition: Task details and download entries show three key artifacts; README explains artifact meaning and rerun purpose
completion_notes: Artifact manifest registered source_pdf, normalized_document_json, translation_manifest_json, translated_pdf; translation_manifest_json downloadable via artifacts/{artifact_key}, render workflow can reuse this protocol based on translations_dir.

task: Remove rendering layer model name file dependency
goal: Remove hardcoded deepseek filenames in rendering loader; prioritize manifest; use old directories as compatibility fallback
done_definition: load_translated_pages supports manifest; old page-*-deepseek.json still renderable; tests cover both paths
completion_notes: load_translated_pages now prioritizes translation-manifest.json and supports explicit manifest path; retained page-*-deepseek.json compatibility fallback; added manifest/legacy test paths.

goal: Cover OCR-only, Translate-only, Render-only, full task compatibility, and old translation directory fallback
done_definition: New Python and Rust tests passed; test descriptions added to corresponding READMEs
completion_notes: Added Python manifest/render input protocol tests and Rust command/job snapshot/workflow tests; covered OCR-only, Translate-only, Render-only, full task compatibility, and legacy page-*-deepseek.json fallback; Python targeted tests 8 passed, Rust 76 passed.

task: Update user and developer documentation entries
goal: Ensure README, doc directory, and module READMEs point to current decoupling boundaries and task ledger
done_definition: Root README retains navigation only; module READMEs define stable boundaries; CSV completion_notes added for every done task
completion_notes: Root README and doc/README updated with Pipeline stage contracts, Rust API task lifecycle, artifact list and download, and architecture decoupling task ledger entries; module READMEs retain stable boundaries and specialized regression commands; CSV updated with all done item completion_notes.

task: Solidify main task API request and response contracts
goal: Make create/list/detail workflow, grouped JSON request body, links/actions semantics stable verifiable interfaces
done_definition: `/api/v1/jobs` uses grouped JSON as main contract; workflow route prefix and submit/list/detail view tests added; main documentation and API_SPEC aligned
completion_notes: Switched `/api/v1/jobs` documentation to `source/ocr/translation/render/runtime` grouped structure; added mineru/translate/render and OCR independent entry boundaries; added Rust tests covering submission view, list/detail links, and actions' workflow prefix contracts.

task: Harden runtime, event stream, and failure diagnosis contracts
goal: Define responsibility boundaries for `runtime.stage_history`, `/events`, `failure`, and `failure_diagnostic` and add test guards
done_definition: Event payloads, terminal failure attribution, and stage timeline responsibilities documented and constrained by unit tests
completion_notes: Clarified `runtime.stage_history` as the source of truth for stage timelines, `/events` for append-only events, and `failure` for structured failures; added Rust tests for `stage_transition` and `job_terminal` payload assertions, locking key fields like stage_history/runtime/failure_category.

task: Solidify artifact manifest and download mapping contract
goal: Ensure consistency between details page artifact overview, manifest, and download routes, and clarify compatible aliases
done_definition: Align common artifact_key, resource_path/resource_url in manifest, and relationship between details artifacts and old download entries in docs and tests
completion_notes: Added description of artifact manifest as formal artifact discovery entry; clarified that `artifacts.pdf/markdown/bundle` in details is the source of truth for page state, while `pdf_url/markdown_url/bundle_url` are kept for compatibility; Rust tests lock download mappings for translated_pdf, markdown_raw, translation_manifest_json, normalized_document_json.

task: Add formula density split layer for overweight blocks
goal: For text with many formula placeholders/segments in a single block, split into smaller blocks by sentence and formula density first, then prioritize plain/tagged to avoid direct multi-window formula translation
done_definition: Implemented overweight block split rules, sub-block context passing, result merging, and placeholder recovery paths; `windowed` request count for real jobs decreased significantly with no new protocol shells/empty translations
completion_notes: Added heavy formula block split in `fallbacks.py`, splitting by sentence boundaries and placeholder/character thresholds; 9 heavy blocks hit in `20260413121000-deepseek-heavyblock-split-smoke`, translation_batches reduced from 185209ms to 141570ms.

task: Shrink windowed-formula to last resort path
goal: Adjust formula routing order so heavy single blocks do not directly enter `windowed-formula` before trying split and plain/tagged failure, reducing 75s-level long-tail requests
done_definition: Routing selection and fallback order adjusted; `windowed` only used for sub-blocks still heavy or plain/tagged validation failed after split; diagnostic fields indicate reason for entering `windowed`
completion_notes: Added pre-split for continuation group and single block layers, `windowed-formula` shrunk to final fallback; same smoke subset dropped from 8 `windowed` to 0, routing changed to 9 `heavy_formula_split`.

task: Tighten tagged/json dual-channel fallback for formula segments
goal: Formula segments default to tagged; fallback to JSON schema only on actual parse failure, avoiding extra JSON request costs for empty segments or known format errors
done_definition: Clear distinction between `tagged_failed/json_failed` diagnostics; empty segments no longer trigger invalid JSON fallback; unit tests cover tagged success, tagged parse failure fallback to JSON, and empty segment direct format failure
completion_notes: `segment_routing.py` now distinguishes tagged failures into parse/shape and semantic categories; `SegmentTranslationSemanticError` terminates current attempt immediately without retrying JSON. Added unit tests for tagged->json and semantic-only paths.

task: Add formula routing and heavy block monitoring fields
goal: Add diagnostics and manifest aggregation for overweight blocks, windowed estimates, and split results to support long-tail analysis by segment_count, placeholder_count, window_count, and formula_density
done_definition: Added heavy formula block statistics to translation_diagnostics and manifest; enables comparison of `windowed` count, p95/max latency, retry count, and split hit rate before and after optimization
completion_notes: Injected `formula_route_decision`, `formula_segment_count`, `formula_window_count`, `formula_density`, `group_split_reason`, etc., into single item diagnostics, and aggregated `formula_route_summary` and `heavy_block_split_summary` in diagnostics summary.

task: Add full-book performance and quality regression
goal: Establish fixed regression sets for known problematic books and formula-dense pages to compare translation time, windowed count, protocol shells, empty translations, English residuals, and rendering results before and after optimization
done_definition: Cover at least the full book and formula-dense subset of `20260412152452-4abf73`; generate before/after comparison summary and write to completion_notes
completion_notes: Acceptance focus is not single-run speed, but significant decrease in `windowed` count, improved total time, and no new placeholder/rendering regressions.
